summary: Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app for Business Central: AI reporting skills let an agent build dashboards in spreadsheets connected to BC data. The app includes 15 generic skills, is free in a sandbox, and needs your own API key (ChatGPT, Claude or others) for the agent.
overview:
Erik Hougaard demonstrates the Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app for Business Central, where spreadsheets are connected to Business Central data. Instead of saving templates manually, users pick a skill, which is a set of instructions for the AI, and say what the report should contain.

The demo creates a new spreadsheet with the agent and shows it building a dashboard with KPI boxes, financial charts and analysis sections. The agent works with the spreadsheet the way a user would. The video closes with how to get and use the app, including the bring your own key requirement.
key_points: The app builds spreadsheets connected with Business Central data.
It ships with about 15 generic skills, including executive summaries, GL exception dashboard, ratio dashboard, budget versus actual and benchmarking dashboards.
A skill is a set of instructions for the AI to build a report or dashboard; it replaces manually saved templates.
You can give the agent specific instructions or let it use the skill defaults.
The demo shows the agent building a dashboard with KPI boxes, financial charts and analysis sections.
The app is free to use in a sandbox.
Using the agent requires your own API key, for example from ChatGPT or Claude (bring your own key).
